facts.fact: ITWeb describes the Information Regulator, chaired by Pansy Tlakula, as South Africa's data privacy enforcer issuing enforcement and infringement notices.
ITWeb reports the Information Regulator issued First National Bank an infringement notice and a R1 million administrative fine for a POPIA section 105 offence over section 19 safeguards.
ITWeb describes the Information Regulator as South Africa's data privacy enforcer issuing notices under POPIA.
ITWeb reports POPIA being enforced by fines, with penalties of up to R10 million and 10 years in jail provided for.

ITWeb reports the Information Regulator issued First National Bank an infringement notice and a R1 million fine under POPIA after 88 home loan applicants' data was exposed to 696 unauthorised individuals.
